text: I feel a sense of curiosity, standing before this glass wall and colorful exhibit labeled 'R+D.' There’s an energy here, a promise of innovation and exploration. The modern decor and technology displays make me aware of the rapidly evolving nature of human understanding. The tilted view adds a touch of disorientation, inviting me to question my own perspective—not just about what I see, but also about what I know and how I come to know it.
